test_modes.name: Scan test
test_modes.purpose: Scanctrl/Scanin/Scanout drive the scan chains for manufacturing DFT.

test_modes.name: Clock control
test_modes.purpose: ClkByp/TestClk bypass/override the functional clock for at-speed test.

test_modes.name: Protocol assertion checking
test_modes.purpose: Simulation-time checks of OCP phase-handshake legality.

spec_provided_observability.name: SResp response code
spec_provided_observability.purpose: NULL/DVA/FAIL/ERR reports transfer success/failure to the master.

spec_provided_observability.name: MError / SError sideband
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Out-of-band error indication outside the dataflow handshake.

spec_provided_observability.name: Phase handshake timing
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observable SCmdAccept / SDataAccept / MRespAccept handshakes for bring-up and protocol checking.

spec_provided_observability.name: MReqInfo / SRespInfo / MDataInfo / SDataInfo
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Info side-channels carry extra information (e.g. parity) with the request/response/data.

spec_provided_observability.name: Test signal group
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Scan (Scanctrl/Scanin/Scanout), JTAG (IEEE 1149.1), and clock control (ClkByp/TestClk) for DFT access.

error_detection_mechanisms: SResp = FAIL / ERR flags failed or unserviceable transfers rather than silently corrupting.
MError / SError sideband signals report errors out of band.
MByteEn / MDataByteEn ensure only intended byte lanes are written.
Protocol checkers verify the request/datahandshake/response handshake rules (SCmdAccept / SDataAccept / MRespAccept timing).

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Slave asserts SInterrupt to the master.
SThreadBusy / MThreadBusy asserted (a thread cannot accept a transfer).

notes: OCP's protocol-level test surface is the SResp response codes, the MError/SError sideband, the SInterrupt mechanism, the info side-channels, and the observability of the phase handshakes. The dedicated test signal group (scan, JTAG IEEE 1149.1, clock control) provides chip-level DFT access through the OCP socket.
